remainingReferences: Ignored .local snapshots/build artifacts and Git history
google-auth-library transitive dependency required by Gemini

limitations: New online rounds/packs do not resolve existing audio using the removed Google voice/content hash; existing URLs and older saved playlists remain playable. A later PWA sync may replace an old playlist with a new pack without audio.
speech_assets records, R2 objects and legacy characters.voiceName remain untouched; no production data inventory was performed.
Reusable storeSpeech helper remains but no current synthesis action calls it; future providers need a separately reviewed workflow.
Browser tests use real components with mocked transport and fixtures, not production data or actual R2 MP3 playback. No physical iPhone/audio device testing.
Whole-source ESLint has five existing loader errors and one existing image warning.
Old running processes/bundles were not restarted; owner must rebuild/restart after reviewing changes.
rollback: Revert only TTS-0 changes and restore package.json/package-lock.json, npm ci, rebuild/restart prior version. No MongoDB/R2 rollback required.
